annotation.title_clean: Commission Regulation (EU) 2017/1347 of 13 July 2017 correcting Directive 2007/46/EC, Regulation (EU) No 582/2011 and Regulation (EU) 2017/1151 on type-approval of motor vehicles with respect to emissions
annotation.title_en: Commission Regulation (EU) 2017/1347 of 13 July 2017 correcting Directive 2007/46/EC, Regulation (EU) No 582/2011 and Regulation (EU) 2017/1151 on type-approval of motor vehicles with respect to emissions
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 192/1
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission regulation correcting technical errors in motor vehicle type-approval rules on Euro 5/6 emissions (Directive 2007/46/EC, Regulations 582/2011, 2017/1221 and 2017/1151 on WLTP). It concerns conventional emissions testing and has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Corrects annexes of Directive 2007/46/EC and Regulations (EU) 582/2011 and 2017/1151
Sets 1 September 2019 as application date for new evaporative emissions test procedure
Clarifies WLTP road load matrix family provisions
Updates Euro 6 emission and OBD standard tables and dates
Enters into force on the third day after publication
